timeline.message:
Snappy: Use unsigned short to handle 2 ^ 16 input size instead of 2 ^ 15

Motivation:

I expect the Snappy compressor to be able to compress a much larger amount than 32767 bytes.

See: https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/13226

Modifications:

- Use unsigned short to handle 2 ^ 16 input size instead of 2 ^ 15
- Avoid iterating to create correct size hash table (limited to MAX_HT_SIZE)
- Configurable snappy frame size for the encoder
- Added static factory method for SnappyEncoder supporting 2 ^ 16 size frame slices
- Added integration test

Result:

Snappy can now compress input up to 2 ^ 16 = 65535 bytes and SnappyEncoder can be instantiated with either support for enlarged slices or traditional
